answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 23942 Country: Pakistan Title: Are women allowed to go to grave yard? Question: does women allowed to go to grave yard, Answer ID: 23942 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1147/885/L=1431) Women can also visit graveyard. However, it is not better for them to visit graveyard; since they mourn there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
